scope.conflict_semantics: Opposite premises conflict only for the same scope. Supplier plurality can coexist with concentration.

assumptions.statement: Omnicorp continually develops its ability to understand, learn and act; products and resources sustain that purpose.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: The owner currently authorises objectives, money and high-stakes steps; technical capability does not grant new authority.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: AI supplies useful bounded cognitive assistance; this does not assume zero costs or universal reliability.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Material scarcity remains a binding constraint on physical expansion in the declared domain and horizon; throughput, experiments and infrastructure limit growth.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Useful physical automation and infrastructure expansion make a declared broad material-provision basket abundant within scope; that basket no longer faces the binding scarcity assumed by ASM-004. This does not mean infinite resources.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Good-enough independently operated AI is affordable for relevant citizen tasks.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: People can form and sustain independent associations in the declared setting.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Ownership of relevant assets and suppliers is plural within the declared scope.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Control of relevant essential infrastructure or suppliers is concentrated within the declared scope.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: AI access is widespread, including among dependent users.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Practical switching or exit from relevant providers is costly.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Public institutions retain independent expertise, audit access, remedies and practicable supplier substitution.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Authorities or providers restrict association or practical exit in the relevant setting.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Local collective adaptation yields independently verified positive net improvement on the specified task during the specified interval under fixed declared budgets, with gains sufficient for that bounded next step.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Adaptive candidates retain isolated evaluation, immutable lineage and rollback.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: No sustained indefinite acceleration is assumed; growth and saturation remain open empirical questions.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: The founder bootstrap has not established demand-side readiness; current phase gates require evidence.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: For the same specified task, interval and resource accounting as ASM-014, verified net gains do not suffice for that bounded next step; the relevant capability or economic returns plateau or disappoint.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Human-facing software tasks may be generated on demand while precise execution and records remain implemented.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: A public remedy can enforce continuity and portability in a bounded essential-service case.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Users have practical alternatives, resources and means of enforcement needed for effective challenge.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: Possible moral-patient welfare protection is accepted as a normative premise in the relevant branch; consciousness remains unresolved.
assumptions.comparison_scope: Compare premises only within the same declared domain, population, task and time interval; different scopes require separate branch records.

assumptions.statement: For the specified output basket, total creation cost falls materially after review, errors, serving and maintenance are counted.

claims.statement: Continual organisational development is the owner purpose, not a law of social evolution.
claims.consequence: Purpose constrains intended Omnicorp design, not empirical outcomes.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Cheap cognition is a baseline premise, not a proven universal zero-cost capability.
claims.consequence: Evaluate useful outcomes and total cost before carrying this premise into a new domain.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: An asset-light wedge can inherit an incumbent throughput bottleneck.
claims.consequence: Do not infer physical output growth merely from better intelligence.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Current high-stakes work retains human authority gates.
claims.consequence: Capability cannot silently remove the current authority rule.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Cooperation depends on incentives, alternatives and enforcement rather than repetition alone.
claims.consequence: A general proof that extraction must lose is not licensed.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Good-enough independent AI can reduce civic work costs without establishing equal power.
claims.consequence: Task competence and bargaining power require separate evidence.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: A bounded adaptation experiment, if reproduced, does not establish unlimited recursive gain.
claims.consequence: The source is contextual evidence for adaptation hypotheses only.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Intelligence-infrastructure feedback does not establish indefinite acceleration.
claims.consequence: Bounded improvement cannot be transferred as an unlimited growth theorem.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Technical capacity and commercial role do not confer a public mandate.
claims.consequence: Authority, capacity and legitimacy remain distinct.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Unknown social baselines are not negative findings.
claims.consequence: A future review must establish baseline before prospective registration.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: External forecasts retain their original criteria and dates; this register does not re-register them.
claims.consequence: Branch mapping does not rewrite frozen probabilistic records.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Substitution and care assistance can push fertility outcomes in opposing directions.
claims.consequence: No demographic probability follows from logical coherence alone.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Reachable exit is weaker than eventual exit under fairness.
claims.consequence: Reachability witness cannot be reported as universal liveness.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Model-welfare protection does not establish consciousness, liability or democratic authority.
claims.consequence: Keep welfare, agency and public mandate as distinct records.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: The original universal incumbent wedge needs a bottleneck-dependent scope.
claims.consequence: Read with CLM-003; do not import universal reachability from the historical definition.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Verification as the sole binding constraint is a conditional claim requiring domain evidence.
claims.consequence: Physical throughput, demand or resources can bind instead; evaluate rather than assume universal dominance.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Cheaper creation can increase supply while demand/distribution remain costly; the proposed economic chain needs product-specific evidence.
claims.consequence: Do not infer paying demand, margins or owned distribution from cheaper generation alone.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: A low-capital digital bootstrap does not establish financing sufficiency for regulated physical expansion.
claims.consequence: Treat founder cashflow and ownership of a physical productive asset as separate capital cases.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Specifying and evaluating outcomes is an operating design whose success depends on meaningful affordable verification.
claims.consequence: A specification or passing proxy cannot establish correctness of an unmeasured real-world outcome.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Deployment in regulated domains depends on liability and acceptance as well as technical performance.
claims.consequence: Do not transfer a successful software benchmark into healthcare/financial authorisation or insurability.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Greenfield redesign avoids some retrofit costs but does not establish zero learning cost or a guaranteed head start.
claims.consequence: The historical analogy motivates a hypothesis, not an elapsed-time multiplier or universal productivity theorem.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.

claims.statement: Team size and 80/20 allocations are workload-dependent heuristics; later evidence changes which human work remains.
claims.consequence: Use measured task performance and review cost; do not formalise a rhetorical ratio as a universal constant.
claims.public_provenance: Editorial qualification; no private source excerpts imported.
